g.text: 1-D lunar landing (g = 1.62 m/s², thrust acceleration 0–4 m/s², 0.2 s steps) from 80–150 m at 5–15 m/s descent; soft landing ≤ 1.5 m/s. Policy: 2–12–1
network trained by the cross-entropy method on return = −Δv/20 − 2 × excess touchdown speed. Shifted test: 20 % less thrust, start up to 20 m/s.
Shield: full braking when the stopping distance at 70 % of rated thrust nears the height.
